t = 4 to time t = 6 is 12.136.
Answer 1 point
Scoring notes:
• The first point is earned for presenting the correct integrand in a definite integral.
• To earn the second point, a response must have earned the first point and must present the value
12.136.
• An unsupported answer of 12.136 does not earn either point.
